title: Family Fun
blurb: Gentle, giggly truths and dares safe for kids, grandparents and everyone between.

truth: What's the silliest rule your family had when you were growing up?
If you could be any animal for a day, which would you pick and why?
What's the best present you've ever been given?
What's a food you refused to eat as a kid but love now?
If you had a superpower for one day, what would you do with it?
What's the funniest thing a family member has said by accident?
Who in your family is the sorest loser at board games?
What's your favourite family holiday memory?
If you could invent a brand new holiday, what would we celebrate?
What's something that scared you as a little kid that seems silly now?
If you could live inside any movie or book, which would it be?
What's the best thing you've ever made with your own hands?
If you could have any animal in the world as a pet, what would you pick?
Which cartoon character are you most like?
If you could swap lives with someone in this room for a day, who would it be?
What's the most trouble you've ever gotten into at home?
What would you put in a time capsule to be opened in 50 years?
What's the best joke you know? Tell it now.
What's the funniest thing a pet has ever done in front of you?
If you could eat only one meal every day for a month, what would it be?
What's the best thing about being the age you are right now?
If you were in charge of dinner tonight, what would be on the menu?
What's the nicest thing someone in this room has done for you?
What would you name a pet dragon?
dare: Waddle across the room like a penguin.
Say the alphabet backwards as fast as you can.
Make up a short song about the person on your left.
Pull the funniest face you can and hold it for ten seconds.
Talk like a pirate until your next turn.
Try to balance a spoon on your nose. You get three tries.
Hop on one foot while saying your full name five times.
Be a robot that has just learnt how to dance.
Tell a story using only animal noises and let the group guess what happened.
Act out a dog seeing its owner come home after a long day.
Name ten fruits in fifteen seconds.
Pretend you're eating the world's longest piece of spaghetti.
Give a one-minute speech on why socks are important.
Draw the person on your right on a phone with your eyes closed.
Copy everything the person on your left says until your next turn.
Strike your best superhero pose and hold it.
Commentate what the person opposite is doing like a sports commentator.
Make someone in the room laugh without saying a single word.
Tell a knock-knock joke and make it as terrible as you can.
Pretend you're a chef on a cooking show making a sandwich out of invisible food.
Act out your favourite animal and let the family guess it.
Walk like you're on the moon for ten steps.
Say something nice to everyone in the room, one word each.
Kindly impersonate the favourite saying of the oldest person in the room.
